description: Verification manifest pinning the expected SHA-256 hash and byte length for every locally bundled DOOM 1.9 reference binary and configuration file under doom/. The focused Bun test re-hashes each file on disk and proves the local bytes match these expected values, so downstream oracle and capture work can trust the reference-source authority order.

entries.description: Vanilla DOOM 1.9 DOS executable; primary behavioral authority for vanilla shareware semantics.
Local merged-polyglot DOOM Windows executable used as a Windows-side practical oracle when behavior agrees with vanilla.
Canonical shareware DOOM IWAD; primary data set for the C1 vanilla parity target.
Vanilla DOOM control, audio, and UI defaults bundled beside the reference binaries.
Host-side oracle configuration including vanilla compatibility flags (vanilla_savegame_limit, vanilla_demo_limit, vanilla_keyboard_mapping).
